title: No No, Wait Wait!
blurb: 'No no no, WAIT WAIT—' — the panicked plea that arrives exactly one second too late. Something irreversible is happening: the send button, the drop, the commitment. This clip is the audio of consequences outrunning objections. Use it in edits at the moment of no return, or in real life constantly, because life is mostly this sound.
origin: A viral too-late panic clip for irreversible moments.
